mapper.select: SELECT pt.product_id, pt.task_id, pt.origin_start_time, pt.origin_end_time, pt.change_start_time, pt.change_end_time, pt.origin_charge_id, pt.change_chrge_id FROM project_plan_task pt LEFT JOIN project_plan pp ON pt.project_plan_id=pp.id WHERE PP.product_id=#{productId} AND PP.status!=#{status}
